verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents triggering workflows from Jira and Linear and building automations that integrate with Linear, suggesting some issue-tracker connectivity, but there is no evidence of ClickUp or Monday.com support, nor of two-way ticket management (creating/updating/closing tickets) versus simple trigger-based automation. missing for 10: ClickUp integration, Monday.com integration, evidence of full ticket-management workflows (not just triggers), independent/hands-on confirmation of these integrations working.
